## Question or proposed change

Describe the result or behavior you want to understand or change.

## Experiment details

Include the code revision, config, scene/split, preprocessing, seed, completed
updates, evaluation settings and hardware. Link relevant metrics or artifacts.

## Reference and comparison

Link the paper or reference implementation and explain the comparison. Identify
whether this is a smoke check, a converged run or a benchmark reproduction.
